class.name: GoapContext
class.brief_description: The data a [GoapAgent] reasons and acts on.
class.description:
Everything a [GoapAction] or a [GoapGoal] is allowed to know about the character it is working for. A context is passed to every virtual method of those resources, which lets a single action or goal resource be shared by any number of agents. It holds two separate stores: - [member world_state] contains the symbolic facts the planner compares. Keep it small and cheap: booleans, integers and strings. Every fact in it is a candidate for a precondition or an effect. - [member blackboard] contains free-form runtime data, such as the node an action is walking towards. The planner never looks at it. [codeblock] func _enter(context): context.set_var(&"target_tree", find_nearest_tree())
func _tick(context, delta): var tree = context.get_var(&"target_tree") if context.agent.global_position.distance_to(tree.global_position) < 1.0: context.set_state(&"has_wood", true) return GoapAction.STATUS_SUCCEEDED return GoapAction.STATUS_RUNNING [/codeblock]

method.name: erase_state
method.description: Removes the fact [param key] from [member world_state]. A missing fact is not the same as a [code]false[/code] one: preconditions asking for it will never be satisfied, but nothing will report a contradiction either.

method.name: get_state
method.description: Returns the value of the fact [param key] in [member world_state], or [param default] if it is not set.

method.name: get_var
method.description: Returns the value stored under [param key] in [member blackboard], or [param default] if it is not set.

method.name: has_state
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the fact [param key] is present in [member world_state], whatever its value.

method.name: has_var
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param key] is present in [member blackboard].

method.name: set_state
method.description: Sets the fact [param key] in [member world_state] to [param value]. Changing a fact does not interrupt the running plan; call [method GoapAgent.request_plan] if the change should force the agent to reconsider immediately.

method.name: set_var
method.description: Stores [param value] under [param key] in [member blackboard].

members.member: The [GoapAgent] this context belongs to, or [code]null[/code] when planning without one. It is typed as [Node] so that actions can reach the character the agent is attached to. The agent sets this on itself; there is rarely a reason to assign it manually.
Free-form runtime data shared between the actions of one agent. Unlike [member world_state], nothing in here takes part in planning, so it can hold node references, vectors, timers or anything else.

The symbolic facts the planner searches over, as a dictionary of [StringName] keys to comparable values. Values are compared by equality, with numbers matching across [int] and [float]. Keeping the vocabulary small directly shrinks the planner's search space.
